svg.aria-description: How a live diagram updates: 3 participants. A page with a live viewer revalidates the picture's address while the page is in view. An unchanged picture costs a 304 and no download; a new version is shown without a reload.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-uoewkl7eyl, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: How a live diagram updates
svg.desc: How a live diagram updates: 3 participants. A page with a live viewer revalidates the picture's address while the page is in view. An unchanged picture costs a 304 and no download; a new version is shown without a reload. Participants: - Your team, person - Plotwork (Library and links), service - plotwork-diagram (live, every 60 s), client Steps: - 1. plotwork-diagram to Plotwork: GET picture (If-None-Match) - 2. Plotwork to plotwork-diagram (dashed): 304 Not Modified - Note over plotwork-diagram: Nothing to download, nothing redrawn - 3. Your team to Plotwork: Publishes a new version - 4. plotwork-diagram to Plotwork: GET picture (If-None-Match) - 5. Plotwork to plotwork-diagram (dashed): 200 with the new SVG and ETag - Note over plotwork-diagram: New fingerprint: swaps the picture, keeps the view, fires plotwork-change
svg.metadata:
sequence "How a live diagram updates" desc="A page with a live viewer revalidates the picture's address while the page is in view. An unchanged picture costs a 304 and no download; a new version is shown without a reload."
actor team person "Your team" actor plot service "Plotwork" sub="Library and links" actor viewer client "plotwork-diagram" sub="live, every 60 s"
viewer -> plot : "GET picture (If-None-Match)" plot --> viewer : "304 Not Modified" note over viewer : "Nothing to download, nothing redrawn"
team -> plot : "Publishes a new version"
viewer -> plot : "GET picture (If-None-Match)" plot --> viewer : "200 with the new SVG and ETag" note over viewer : "New fingerprint: swaps the picture, keeps the view, fires plotwork-change"

g.data-message: 200 with the new SVG and ETag
g.text: 200 with the new SVG and ETag
